verdict.rationale: BugSnag publishes a documented public Data Access API with an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec on SwaggerHub. Its developer portal reference is generated from that spec and covers authentication, pagination, rate limiting and versioning, which is a clear programmatic surface an AI-native user or agent can drive. The 404s on docs.bugsnag.com OpenAPI paths only show the spec is hosted elsewhere, not that it is absent. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the API supports write/action operations (e.g., changing error status or assignment) rather than only data access, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
